title: The optimal road trip across the U.S. according to machine learning

quoted_total.source: post text: '13,699 miles (22,046 km) of driving...about 224 hours (9.33 days) of driving in total'

stops.name: Grand Canyon National Park Lodges
stops.query: Grand Canyon National Park Lodges, 88 Village Loop Drive, Grand Canyon Village, AZ 86023
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Display = Grand Canyon Village Historic District (Wikidata P625), the rim lodge cluster on Village Loop Drive (El Tovar, Kachina, Thunderbird, Bright Angel) that the query 'Grand Canyon National Park Lodges, 88 Village Loop Drive' names; the exact '88' street number could not be located. Drive = Village Loop Drive by Bright Angel Lodge. The optimizer's distance matrix used a different string ('Grand Canyon National Park, Arizona'), so the matrix check does not apply to this page string.

stops.name: Bryce Canyon National Park
stops.query: Bryce Canyon National Park, Hwy 63, Bryce, UT
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Bryce Canyon Visitor Center on Hwy 63 (Wikidata P625). Matrix offset within noise (about -2 km).

stops.name: Craters of the Moon National Monument & Preserve
stops.query: Craters of the Moon National Monument & Preserve, Arco, ID
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Robert Limbert Visitor Center, 1266 Craters Loop Rd, on US 20/26/93 (recreation.gov POI coordinates; Wikidata Q1139053 P625 is 150 m away). Old Nominatim point was 6 km SE in the lava field.

stops.name: West Yellowstone Visitor Information Center
stops.query: West Yellowstone Visitor Information Center, 30 Yellowstone Ave, West Yellowstone, MT 59758
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. West Yellowstone Visitor Information Center, 30 Yellowstone Ave (NPS API coordinates for the NPS desk; the Census address match is 100 m E). The optimizer's matrix used 'Yellowstone National Park, WY 82190' instead, so the matrix check does not apply to this page string.

stops.name: Pikes Peak
stops.query: Pikes Peak, Colorado
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Pikes Peak summit (Wikidata P625), car-reachable via the Pikes Peak Highway; drive = summit parking.

stops.name: Carlsbad Caverns National Park
stops.query: Carlsbad Caverns National Park, Carlsbad, NM
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Carlsbad Caverns visitor center at the end of Walnut Canyon Desert Drive (the park's Wikidata P625 sits on it). Old Nominatim point was 16 km SW, off the road network. Matrix offset +8 km, within long-haul noise.

stops.name: The Alamo
stops.query: The Alamo, Alamo Plaza, San Antonio, TX
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Alamo Mission (Wikidata P625). Alamo Plaza is pedestrian, so the router snaps to E Houston St about 65 m north.

stops.name: Chickasaw National Recreation Area
stops.query: Chickasaw National Recreation Area, 1008 W 2nd St, Sulphur, OK 73086
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. 1008 W 2nd St, Sulphur (Census address match), the park headquarters address in the query, at the north edge of the Platt District. Matrix offset +8 km (near stops); a point at Lake of the Arbuckles fits the 2015 matrix better, so Google may have used the recreation area's centroid. Kept the query's address.

stops.name: Toltec Mounds
stops.query: Toltec Mounds, Scott, AR
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Toltec Mounds, renamed Plum Bayou Mounds Archeological State Park in 2022 (Wikidata P625). Drive = park entrance road near the visitor center (the nearest routable road is about 300 m from the mound point). Old Nominatim point was 3.4 km WSW.

stops.name: Graceland
stops.query: Graceland, Elvis Presley Boulevard, Memphis, TN
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Graceland mansion (Wikidata P625); drive = 3764 Elvis Presley Blvd (Census).

stops.name: Vicksburg National Military Park
stops.query: Vicksburg National Military Park, Clay Street, Vicksburg, MS
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Visitor center at 3201 Clay St (Census address match), the park entrance the query names; the park's Wikidata P625 (Q12072131) is 430 m SE on the tour road.

stops.name: French Quarter
stops.query: French Quarter, New Orleans, LA
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. French Quarter (Wikidata P625), central Quarter by Orleans St.

stops.name: USS Alabama
stops.query: USS Alabama, Battleship Parkway, Mobile, AL
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. USS Alabama at Battleship Memorial Park (Wikidata P625); drive snaps to the park lot off Battleship Pkwy.

stops.name: Cape Canaveral
stops.query: Cape Canaveral, FL
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Display = the cape itself (Wikidata P625), inside restricted Cape Canaveral Space Force Station (the post lists 'Cape Canaveral Air Force Station'). Drive = City of Cape Canaveral (Wikidata Q966657), the public place the string 'Cape Canaveral, FL' resolves to; the 2015 distance matrix fits the city (offset -0.5 km) and not the cape (-12 km).

stops.name: Okefenokee Swamp Park
stops.query: Okefenokee Swamp Park, Okefenokee Swamp Park Road, Waycross, GA
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Okefenokee Swamp Park at the end of Okefenokee Swamp Park Rd (Wikidata P625).

stops.name: Fort Sumter National Monument
stops.query: Fort Sumter National Monument, Sullivan's Island, SC
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Display = Fort Sumter in Charleston Harbor (Wikidata P625), boat-only. Drive = ferry departure at Liberty Square, Fort Sumter Visitor Education Center (Wikidata Q37883344). The 2015 matrix fits Liberty Square (offset 0 km) over Patriots Point (-5 km) and Fort Moultrie on Sullivan's Island (-12 km), despite 'Sullivan's Island' in the query.

stops.name: Lost World Caverns
stops.query: Lost World Caverns, Lewisburg, WV

stops.name: Wright Brothers National Memorial Visitor Center
stops.query: Wright Brothers National Memorial Visitor Center, Manteo, NC
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Wright Brothers National Memorial Visitor Center, Kill Devil Hills (Wikidata P625; 'Manteo' in the query is the park's mailing town). Matrix offset +18 to +23 km from northern stops, most likely a 2015 Google road choice via US 64 and Manteo, since the southern stop fits the visitor center.

stops.name: Mount Vernon
stops.query: Mount Vernon, Fairfax County, Virginia
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Mount Vernon mansion (Wikidata P625); drive = estate entrance lot at the south end of the George Washington Memorial Pkwy.

stops.name: White House
stops.query: White House, Pennsylvania Avenue Northwest, Washington, DC
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. White House (Wikidata P625). Pennsylvania Ave in front is closed to cars, so drive = 17th St NW beside the Eisenhower Building, 240 m west.

stops.name: Maryland State House
stops.query: Maryland State House, 100 State Cir, Annapolis, MD 21401
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Maryland State House (Wikidata P625); drive = State Circle.

stops.name: New Castle Historic District
stops.query: New Castle Historic District, Delaware
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. New Castle Historic District (Wikidata P625, by The Green and the Court House). OPEN DOUBT: the 2015 distance matrix shows Google never matched this string. Its point was Google's generic 'Delaware' point near Dover (38.9108,-75.5277): residuals are 0 to 4 km there versus 23 to 106 km at New Castle. So the 2015 route went about 85 km south of New Castle. Kept the named place; to reproduce the 2015 line exactly, set drive to 38.9108,-75.5277.

stops.query: Liberty Bell, 6th Street, Philadelphia, PA
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Liberty Bell Center (Wikidata P625); drive = S 6th St. Old Nominatim point (40.088,-74.967) was 16 km NE in Bucks County.

stops.name: Statue of Liberty
stops.query: Statue of Liberty, Liberty Island, NYC, NY
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Display = Statue of Liberty (Wikidata P625), boat-only. Drive = Battery Place by Castle Clinton, the Manhattan ferry departure (Castle Clinton Q1049423). The 2015 matrix fits the Battery (offset +0.4 km) over Liberty State Park, NJ (+4 km).

stops.query: The Mark Twain House & Museum, Farmington Avenue, Hartford, CT
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Mark Twain House (Wikidata P625); drive = 351 Farmington Ave (Census).

stops.name: USS Constitution
stops.query: USS Constitution, Boston, MA
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. USS Constitution at Pier 1, Charlestown Navy Yard (Wikidata P625). Old Nominatim point was 470 m SW, across the channel.

stops.name: Acadia National Park
stops.query: Acadia National Park, Maine
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Display = the park's Wikidata P625 (Dorr and Champlain Mountain area, east Mount Desert Island). Drive = Sand Beach lot on the one-way Park Loop Road. The 2015 matrix rules out Hulls Cove Visitor Center (Google's route ended about 22 km beyond it): Sand Beach fits within 4 to 9 km, and Schoodic Point fits similarly. The exact 2015 endpoint is uncertain.

stops.name: Omni Mount Washington Resort
stops.query: Omni Mount Washington Resort, Mount Washington Hotel Road, Bretton Woods, NH
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Omni Mount Washington Resort hotel (Wikidata P625); drive = hotel entrance off US 302. Matrix offset +10 km varies by partner, so it reflects road choice, not a misplaced point.

stops.name: Shelburne Farms
stops.query: Shelburne Farms, Harbor Road, Shelburne, VT
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Shelburne Farms Welcome Center, 1611 Harbor Rd (Census address match), the Harbor Road point the query names. Wikidata Q7493326 P625 (the estate) is 1.8 km SW. Matrix residuals vary by partner (-13 to +9 km), which points to road choice.

stops.name: USS Cod Submarine Memorial
stops.query: USS Cod Submarine Memorial, East 9th Street, Cleveland, OH
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Extra waypoint the original route inserted in Cleveland to avoid routing through Canada (not one of the 50 landmarks and not in the 2015 matrix). Kept as is: USS Cod, East 9th St pier, matches Wikidata P625 within 10 m.

stops.name: Olympia Entertainment
stops.query: Olympia Entertainment, Woodward Avenue, Detroit, MI
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Olympia Entertainment's 2015 offices were at 2211 Woodward Ave, the Fox Theatre / Fox Office Centre building (BBB, Yelp, Wikipedia 'Fox Theatre (Detroit)'), which the post lists as 'Fox Theater, Detroit'. Display = Fox Theatre (Wikidata P625); drive = 2211 Woodward Ave (Census).

stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Spring Grove Cemetery (Wikidata P625, by the main gate); drive = main entrance, 4521 Spring Grove Ave (Census). Old Nominatim point was 1.5 km NW, inside the grounds.

stops.query: Mammoth Cave National Park, Mammoth Cave Pkwy, Mammoth Cave, KY
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Mammoth Cave visitor center on Mammoth Cave Pkwy (Wikidata P625). Matrix offset -8 km, likely because the 2015 Google route used the Green River ferry or another approach.

stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Lincoln Home NHS Visitor Center, 426 S 7th St (Census address match); Lincoln Home itself (Wikidata Q3304667) is 130 m NE.

stops.query: Mount Rushmore National Memorial, South Dakota 244, Keystone, SD
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Mount Rushmore sculpture (Wikidata P625); drive = visitor parking by the Lincoln Borglum Museum, 340 m SE.

stops.name: Fort Union Trading Post National Historic Site
stops.query: Fort Union Trading Post National Historic Site, Williston, North Dakota 1804, ND
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Fort Union Trading Post (Wikidata P625); drive = site parking off ND 1804.

stops.name: Glacier National Park
stops.query: Glacier National Park, 64 Grinnell Drive, West Glacier, MT 59936
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Park headquarters at 64 Grinnell Dr, West Glacier, in the Headquarters Historic District (Wikidata P625; the Census interpolation of 64 Grinnell Dr is 650 m W on the same road). Old Nominatim point (48.370,-114.187) was outside the park. The optimizer's matrix used 'Glacier National Park, West Glacier, MT', so the matrix check applies only loosely.

stops.name: Hanford Site
stops.query: Hanford Site, Benton County, WA
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Hanford Site is a restricted DOE reservation. Display = B Reactor National Historic Landmark (Wikidata P625), the public face of the site (Manhattan Project NHP). Drive = B Reactor access road, reachable by the public only on the NPS tour bus from Richland. The 2015 matrix fits a central-site point (B Reactor or the site's Wikidata point) within about 1 to 3 km for Columbia Gorge and Craters, and rules out Richland (+18 to +73 km).

stops.name: Columbia River Gorge National Scenic Area
stops.query: Columbia River Gorge National Scenic Area, Oregon
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Display and drive = Deschutes River State Recreation Area at the NSA's eastern end (I-84 exit 97). The 2015 matrix is decisive: Google's point for this string sat about 110 km east of Multnomah Falls, fitting the Deschutes mouth and Biggs area (offset -5 km versus -117 km at Multnomah Falls). The exact Google point is uncertain to about 15 km.

stops.name: Cable Car Museum
stops.query: Cable Car Museum, 94108, 1201 Mason St, San Francisco, CA 94108
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. San Francisco Cable Car Museum (Wikidata P625); drive = 1201 Mason St (Census).

stops.name: San Andreas Fault
stops.query: San Andreas Fault, San Benito County, CA
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. San Andreas Fault crossing of CA 25 (Airline Hwy), a known creep site with offset pavement about 10 min north of Pinnacles east entrance (36.59841,-121.19450). The query names only the county. The 2015 matrix rules out Hollister and San Juan Bautista (+46 to +66 km on the SF leg) and fits this Hwy 25 corridor (offset -5 km). Old Nominatim point was on the Peninsula in Santa Clara County.

stops.name: Hoover Dam
stops.query: Hoover Dam, Boulder City, CO
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Hoover Dam (Wikidata P625); the query's 'Boulder City, CO' is a typo for Nevada (the matrix string is 'Hoover Dam, NV'). Drive = visitor center area on Hoover Dam Access Rd. Old Nominatim point was Hoover Dam Lodge in Boulder City, 4 km W.
